description.value: On the Run is a Chevron-affiliated convenience store chain location operating around the clock on Adams Road in Kelowna. The site includes a restaurant, fuel options (94 Octane, Diesel), and EV charging alongside a standard convenience store. Touring cyclists will find washrooms and food available at any hour.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content for this location is available and confirms an active 24-hour Chevron On the Run convenience store at 105 Adams Rd, Kelowna, BC V1X 7R1. The amenities list on the website explicitly names Washrooms, Restaurant, and Convenience store, and lists EV Charging and Air as additional services. No mention of bike-specific parking, bike racks, or water bottle refill is made anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
